sources.scope: Statbel Belgium-wide top 10,000 family names in 2026, drawn from national column (not merged Flemish/Walloon/Brussels frequencies); rank used for choosing unweighted new entries.
sources.limitations: 2026 resident population names, not citizenship or births, top-10,000 coverage only. 500 older independently regional source-attested entries retained even if outside 2026 national top 10,000. No per-surname rank, weight or frequency stored; official statistics attribution and licensing require review.
